# Before / After

`comparison/before-after` &middot; section-level &middot; category: comparison

## Purpose

Two images side by side, labelled Before and After, with a caption under each. They stack on phones.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `before` | object { image, label, caption } |  |
| `after` | object { image, label, caption } |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Before on the left, After on the right.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Two columns as a table row. | Stacking works. Non-Google Gmail accounts show the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('comparison/before-after', {
  "heading": "One repair, good as new",
  "before": {
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/280x280/png?text=Before",
      "alt": "A linen shirt with a torn elbow"
    },
    "caption": "Torn elbow after six years of wear."
  },
  "after": {
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/280x280/png?text=After",
      "alt": "The same shirt with an invisible woven repair on the elbow"
    },
    "caption": "Invisibly mended in our workshop, free."
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "comparison/before-after",
  "data": {
    "heading": "One repair, good as new",
    "before": {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/280x280/png?text=Before",
        "alt": "A linen shirt with a torn elbow"
      },
      "caption": "Torn elbow after six years of wear."
    },
    "after": {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/280x280/png?text=After",
        "alt": "The same shirt with an invisible woven repair on the elbow"
      },
      "caption": "Invisibly mended in our workshop, free."
    }
  }
}
```
